question: Which product sold the most units in July 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','fulfilled') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-07' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Top 3 products by revenue across all months.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','fulfilled') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many units of the Herbal Mouth Spray were sold in August 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE p.sku='HF-SPRAY' AND o.status IN ('paid','fulfilled') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-08'

question: Units sold per product in June 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','fulfilled') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-06' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC

question: How many units did the lowest-selling product sell in May 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(units) AS units FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','fulfilled') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-05' GROUP BY oi.product_id)

question: What is the gross margin percentage of the Fluoride-Free Starter Bundle?

question: List all products with their price and cost.

question: How many active products do we sell?

question: Total gross profit in July 2026 (units times price minus cost)?

question: Average items per order in August 2026?

question: How many orders in July 2026 included the Bamboo Facial Tissue?

question: Revenue from the oral_care category versus other categories in August 2026.
